description: This file contains test cases written using pytest to validate a FastAPI application. It includes fixture setup for the test client, parameterized tests for endpoint responses, and schema validation for OpenAPI specifications.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports the specified FastAPI module based on test parameters and returns a TestClient instance for it.

methods.description: Validates the OpenAPI schema retrieved from the FastAPI application for correctness.
